claims.statement: Use the ground-electronic-singlet trans-H-C-OH to H2CO channel with AE-CCSD(T)/cc-pCVQZ stationary structures and focal-point energy corrections. claims.statement: The source reduced reaction-path/WKB calculation predicts a near-0-K H-C-OH half-life of 122 min, reported as 2.0 h, and a H-C-OD half-life over 1200 yr. Figure 4 uses focal-point plus harmonic zero-point energies relative to CO+H2: trans reactant 54.2 and TS2 83.9 kcal/mol, with the displayed difference 29.7 kcal/mol; the trans anharmonic value is 54.0. Schwinger's two-page 1948 letter announces a leading perturbative magnetic correction with renormalized experimental mass and a separate discussion of charge renormalization. In its Gaussian-unit convention alpha=e^2/(hbar*c), the displayed correction becomes a_e^(1)=alpha/(2*pi). The low-order formula does not reproduce modern higher-order QED, lepton, hadronic or weak contributions, nor does Fan's experimental extraction require the Schwinger term as a calibration input.
